comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is positive when a comment uses a specific, verifiable procedural example, meaning a concrete real process, rule or case. Feature 1 is positive when a comment rebuts mainly through abstract logic and contains no named real-world example or analogy. Feature 1 needs the absence of specific examples, so the two are close to opposite in scope. They also differ in eligibility: feature 0 covers any procedural example, while feature 1 requires a rebuttal that is mainly abstract.
